§6Core Drawers & Aesthetics§f

§aDitch the chest maze and see what you've got at a glance.§f

Drawers show their item on the front face, so you always know what's inside. §9Right-click§f to insert a stack, §9double-right-click§f to dump all matching items, §9left-click§f to grab one, and §9shift + left-click§f for a full stack.

§6Drawer Types§f:
§b• 1x1 Full Drawer§f: 1 item type, §e32 stacks§f capacity.
§b• 1x2 Full Drawer§f: 2 item types, §e16 stacks§f each.
§b• 2x2 Full Drawer§f: 4 item types, §e8 stacks§f each.
§b• Compacting Drawer§f: Stores compressible items like iron or redstone. Automatically converts between §bBlocks§f, §bIngots§f, and §bNuggets§f. Capacity is §e16 stacks§f.

Breaking a drawer keeps everything inside. Move it wherever you want without items spilling out.

§6Custom Looks§f:
Use a §bFraming Table§f to restyle drawers with any blocks you like. Add structural blocks for the body, trim blocks for edges, and face blocks for the front. §cNote:§f The decoration blocks are consumed during crafting.

§ePS:§f A single 1x1 drawer holding 32 stacks of cobblestone already beats a chest.
